name: dockrune Self-Hosted Deployment Daemon
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted Go deployment daemon for GitHub push-webhook-triggered Docker deployments; no software subscription or vendor-enforced usage quota. Run the binary or Docker container on your own server.
watch_out: Requires a user-provided VPS or server, Docker, GitHub webhook configuration and TLS/security hardening; infrastructure, domain and network charges are not included. Webhook secret and admin credentials must be configured. Do not mistake free self-hosted software for free hosted compute.
